title: B2 Milestone 7: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has superado el Séptimo Hito del Nivel B2. Ya manejas estructuras gramaticales de alto impacto (Inversión, Cláusulas de Participio) y vocabulario específico para dominar reuniones, ventas y estrategias corporativas.

parts.visual:
En este hito repasaremos las lecciones 31 a 34 del nivel B2: 
- Participle Clauses (Reading the report..., Manufactured in Germany...). 
- Advanced Inversion (Never have I seen..., Hardly had we started...).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 31 to 34 of the B2 level: Participle Clauses, such as 'Reading the report' or 'Manufactured in Germany', and Advanced Inversion, like 'Never have I seen' or 'Hardly had we started'.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos tu uso de vocabulario de negocios clave: 
- Meetings & Negotiations (Deadlock, compromise, leverage, counter-offer). 
- Marketing & Sales (Target audience, brand awareness, conversion rate, sales pitch). 
¡Prepárate para demostrar tus habilidades ejecutivas!
parts.audio: We will also test your use of key business vocabulary: Meetings and Negotiations, including words like deadlock, compromise, leverage, and counter-offer. And Marketing and Sales, with terms like target audience, brand awareness, conversion rate, and sales pitch. Get ready to show your executive skills!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador B2.

questions.question: ____ out of budget, the team had to abandon the project. (Habiéndose quedado - perfect participle).
questions.explanation: Perfect Participle: Having + participio pasado (Having run out of budget).

questions.question: Never before ____ such a high conversion rate on our website. (Nunca antes hemos visto).
questions.explanation: Inversión avanzada: Never before + have + sujeto + participio.

questions.question: The negotiations reached a ____. Nobody wanted to make any concessions. (Punto muerto).
We need to do some market ____ before launching this product. (Investigación).
____ in China, the new phones are very affordable. (Fabricados - pasivo).
Not only ____ our price, but they also offered a faster delivery. (No solo igualaron).
questions.explanation: Inversión: Not only + did + sujeto + verbo.

questions.question: If we want to close the deal, we will have to ____ on the price. (Ceder mutuamente / Llegar a un acuerdo).
She gave a brilliant sales ____ to the investors. (Discurso de venta).
____ the email quickly, I completely missed the attachment. (Leyendo).
Hardly ____ the meeting when the fire alarm started ringing. (Apenas habíamos empezado).
questions.explanation: Inversión con Hardly: Hardly + had + sujeto + participio.

questions.question: We rejected their offer of $500 and made a ____ of $650. (Contraoferta).
Word of ____ is our best marketing tool right now. (Boca a boca).
Not ____ what to say, the manager remained silent. (No sabiendo).
Under no circumstances ____ give them our clients' data! (Debes tú).
questions.explanation: Inversión de modal: Under no circumstances + should + you.

questions.question: After discussing for 3 hours, the board finally reached a ____. (Consenso).
Our ____ audience consists of college students aged 18 to 22. (Público objetivo).
____ frustrated by the delay, the client called our CEO directly. (Sintiéndose).
Only then ____ how important the contract was. (Me di cuenta yo).
questions.explanation: Inversión: Only then + did + I + realize.

questions.question: We have the ____ in this negotiation because they need us desperately. (Poder/Ventaja).
He hates cold ____ because most people hang up the phone on him. (Llamadas en frío).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel B2.

questions.question: ____ (Read) the file, I noticed an error. (Leyendo)
____ (Found) in 2010, the company is growing fast. (Fundada)
Never ____ seen this. (he yo - Inversión)
Not only ____ late... (llegó él - Inversión con D)
questions.explanation: did he arrive (o 'did he' dependiendo de cómo lo escriban, pero pedimos 1 palabra. Pondremos 'did he'). Corregido a 'did he'.

questions.question: Reach a ____. (Punto muerto con D)
Make a ____-offer. (Contraoferta)
Target ____. (Público con A)
Brand ____. (Reconocimiento con A)
Sales ____. (Discurso/Presentación con P)
Little ____ know. (sabíamos nosotros - Inversión con D)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración para tu examen final del bloque 7.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Reading the report, I found an error.
options: Reading the report, I found an error.
Read the report, I found an error.
Having read the report, I find an error.
Reading the record, I found an error.
questions.correct_answer: Reading the report, I found an error.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Never have I seen such a mistake.
options: Never have I seen such a mistake.
Never I have seen such a mistake.
Never did I see such a mistake.
Never I saw such a mistake.
questions.correct_answer: Never have I seen such a mistake.

Not only does he arrive late, but he forgot his laptop.
